name: builder-painted-pipe
description: Issue #229: a Builder's placement preview (the flying cube of each queued pipe) beside a placed painted pipe, to compare the preview on NeoForge 1.21.1 and Forge 1.21.1. Generated by generators/gen_builder_painted_pipe.py, whose docstring describes the rig.

steps.label: creative, peaceful, daylight; the rig's chunks loaded
window 1600x900
clear and floor
source row: painted item pipes (red, lime, blue), a plain one, a painted fluid pipe, a plain one, red stained glass
the source pipes kept their paint (red item pipe is RED, the plain one has none, the fluid pipe is RED)
architect facing north with its box set and a blank blueprint in
the architect finished its blueprint
chest: the used blueprint in slot 0, then into the player's first slot
run: data modify block {X-15} {Y} {Z-2} Items[{Slot:0b}] merge from block {X-11} {Y} {Z-2} items.out.items[0].stack
item replace entity @p inventory.0 from block {X-15} {Y} {Z-2} container.0

steps.label: reference row: the same seven cells, placed by command, three blocks south of the site
viewpoints: barrier blocks to stand on
Builder facing north: owner, NO power and no pipes yet

steps.name: pp-ref-before
steps.look: the REFERENCE row (south of the empty site): three painted item pipes (red, lime, blue) tinted translucent over their glass, a plain one, a red fluid pipe with an opaque red border and a plain one, then a red stained-glass block. The site row behind it is still empty, the Builder (north of it) idle

steps.label: open the Builder
hover the blueprint in the inventory
hover it again now that the snapshot has arrived

steps.name: blueprint-tooltip
steps.look: the blueprint's tooltip with its 3D preview underneath (a 100x100 panel): the seven cells drawn without a level: painted item pipes tinted, the fluid pipe's red border, the red glass cube

steps.label: pick the blueprint up from the inventory
put it in the Builder's snapshot slot
the Builder holds the blueprint (expect snapshotType 1)
tick rate 4: the build now takes about sixteen seconds
give the Builder its pipes and the battery: it starts
the place tasks of the Builder: the items the cubes fly as (a plain pipe item each: no paint component)
